$comment: The location of the open Lindelaan Woo request (Openbare verlichting fietspad Lindelaan), so its Locaties card on DqZaak and DqZaakMeer reads "1 location" with a point on the short map and the address under it, as the boards draw it (locations-card-board task 2.1). The point is on the Lindelaan in Zuiddrecht, beside the waste report there; the closed copy of the request carries its own location (63-closed-lindelaan-woo.json).
